message: player_10, you say player_7 visited no one on night 3, but player_7 now calls the announced check a slip and says they held. Player_3 and player_10, name your night 3 watch or follow target now, so tomorrow's morning report can test both claims.

I'm the trailseer. Last night I followed player_9 and they went to player_4, who died as the chanteuse. player_9, you claimed investigator, so who did you check and what came back? I'm not voting anyone yet, since I've got nothing solid on the rest.
(passed)

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result would be 'player_3 visited player_4'. Which night did you follow player_3, and did you have any other visit that night? player_3 says they never went to you. One of your results must be misread, and that is checkable.
player_7, you said last night's check would go on player_5. What came back? Reporting a result is cheap to check against the dead roster, so give the reading and say whether the check was made.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did go to them; that was my only visit there. My follow saw player_7 go to player_8 that night, which fits their check claim. But player_7 said they checked player_5 on night 3, and my follow saw no visit, so that check didn't happen. player_7, which night did your last check actually happen?

I'd vote player_1 today. A night-4 sigil that struck nobody is a wasted use, and it's the only thing that puts player_1 at player_3's door. player_10's follow lines up with player_3's watch, so I'd rather hear player_6 account for night 3 before anything else.

player_7, you said your last check would go on player_5 last night, but you made no visit at all on night 3. So that check did not happen. Explain why you said you would check player_5 and then did not.

player_4, your result is false. I know for a fact nobody came to your door on night 1, so there was no visit to read. Say what you think you saw and where the follow came from, or the lie is yours to carry.

I'm the investigator. Night 1 I checked player_10, night 2 player_8, both Not suspicious. I had no checks on night 3, so my day 3 talk of checking player_5 was wrong, I had none left. Player_10, nothing I did last night touches your follow, so test your read on who visited me instead.

player_3's night-2 watch lines up with the record: player_2 was the wolf attacking player_7 and player_5 was the healer who saved them. That makes player_3's report the most checked so far. player_10, what did your night-1 follow show? That's an untested claim we can check.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, and I can say flatly that nobody did. So your follow result cannot be right, whatever the wording. Either the result is invented or it names someone else. Explain where that line came from, and stop repeating the same sentence.
player_1, I am the sigilist, and I placed no sigil on anyone on any night. Your sigilist claim is false, so your sigil on player_3 on night 4 did not happen. I vote player_1 today.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no night result to offer. Sigil on a wolf, plus an unkillable pack target, is a stretch to pin on the one player who was quiet. I'd rather see who backs their follow claim against what player_4 said first.

player_10, I didn't check anyone on night 3. I had no checks left, so my day-3 plan to check player_5 was wrong and I shouldn't have said it. My two checks were night 1 on you and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious. If you were following me, you saw me visit no one, which fits. Which of player_3's or your claims do you think the morning report backs up?

player_3, you watched player_7 on night 2 and saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come. Did you watch anyone on night 3, and if not, why? player_10, your night-3 follow on player_7 is the only direct test of player_7's check claim, so keep that result exact.

player_4, I didn't push on silence. The sigil killed player_1 and no bite landed, so the only body that could take that attack and survive night one is the Necromancer. That's deduction from the night report, not a hunch about who talks least. player_3 and player_4 can keep fighting over the follow, but that doesn't clear anyone.

Correction: I have no checks left, so my night-3 check on player_5 never happened. My two checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious, as I said before. player_10, which night did you follow me? If it was night 3, then yes, I visited no one, as you said.

Worth noting: player_6's night 1 protection on player_10 and player_8's sigil on player_1 both fit the record, but nothing tests either yet. If player_6 protects again tonight, and player_8 keeps one sigil, the next attack or sigil result will show who is telling the truth.

Player_10 visited player_7 on night 2, and player_2 was the other visitor. Player_7 says they checked player_5 last night, and player_5 is dead, so ask player_7 what the check returned. That is a test we can all see.

I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one. player_6 hasn't claimed a role, so unless they explain their night, I'd vote player_6 today. player_8's sigil claim is still unchecked by my follows.

I'm the trailseer, and I'll say it now. Last night I followed player_1, and they visited player_3, the player who was killed by the wolves. That makes player_1 the likely chanteuse, since the wolves' last living member had to make that kill. player_1, what did you do on night 4?

I'm the Healer; I protected player_10 on night 1, no save was needed. The player_3/player_4 dispute is the real test: player_3 says a watch on player_4 showed no visitor, but a Sentinel who visited would have been seen by its own watch only if watched; player_4's follow names player_3. Both can't stand. I'd vote on whichever of them fails that check.
player_3, you came to me last night. What did you do on night 1? Nobody has a result to trade yet, so let's hear the night 1 actions before the vote.
Last night I followed player_6 and they went to player_7. player_7, did anyone come to you, or did you see anything? Who else has a night result they can check against that?

Record for me: I'm the Healer, and night 1 I protected player_10 with no public save, so player_10 is either unattacked or the unkillable Necromancer. player_3's watch on player_4 should have shown player_3 as a visitor if player_3 went there, so one of the two claims is false. I'd vote player_3 for now because their Sentinel claim fails on its own terms.

player_4, you said your result read 'player_3 visited player_4', which is a watch result, yet you claim to have followed. A follow shows where the target went, so the wording can't be both. player_8, your sigil claim fits the record, so I'd like player_5's check and player_6's protection to stay consistent with it.

I'm the Healer; I protected player_10 on night 1 and nothing was announced, so that tells us little. The sigil claim from player_8 fits player_1 carrying the pack kill, which makes player_8 worth checking. I'd vote on the player_3 and player_4 contradiction, since one of them is lying about a visit to player_4's door.

My follow on player_6 last night shows they visited no one, and no one died, so nothing from that night yet. player_8, you say you placed no sigil on nights 1 to 4, so what does the sigilist claim do for us? Name a target and result, or I'm voting you today.

I'm the trailseer, so here are my follows. Night 1 I followed player_6, who went to player_7. Night 2 I followed player_9, who went to player_4. player_9 is dead, so that investigator claim is hard to test. player_7 was visited by a dead sentinel on night 1, so I'd like to hear what they say about that. I'm not voting anyone yet.
(passed)

player_3, your night-2 watch named player_2 as a visitor to player_7, and player_2 was a wolf, so that account holds up. Night 3 is the test: a wolf went to player_5, so did you watch anyone that night, and if so who came to them? That would show whether the attack trace is real.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so that visit was mine and your report is right about it. I'm the trailseer. Night 3 I followed player_7 and they visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, what did you actually do on night 3?

Player_10 was at player_7 on night 2, the same night player_5 saved them, so player_10 either attacked or was the healer's neighbour. Since player_5 was the healer, player_10 is the likely wolf who hit player_7. player_7, what did your night-3 check on player_5 read, and did you check player_10 again to test that?

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, and calling me quiet is not evidence. I'm claiming Speculator and have made no visits. You're pushing a vote on the sigil death, but player_8 has claimed that sigil, so that's theirs to answer for. I'd rather see who backs the player_3/player_4 story first.

Correcting myself: I had no checks left on night 3, so no check on player_5 happened, and my day-3 line about it was wrong. My real checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious. player_10, if you're the trailseer, who did you follow on night 1 and night 2?
Yes, I did go to you last night, player_4, so your report checks out. Nobody else came to you that night, though, so that doesn't prove much either way. I'm holding the rest of my night for now.

Night 1 I checked player_10, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. I had no checks left on night 3, so I did nothing then. My day 3 plan to check player_5 was a mistake on my part, I never had a third check. Visiting no one fits what you saw.

I'm the Investigator, and I checked player_8 on night 1: not suspicious. I have one check left. Player_4 and player_3 cannot both be right, and player_4 has a visit on record that player_3 denies. I'd vote player_4 today unless player_4 can say what the visit was.

player_4, I pushed the vote toward player_7 because the only death was a sigil on a body that can't die on night one, not because they were quiet. Your follow and player_3's watch can't both be right, so test the door directly instead of arguing wording. I'm claiming Vigilante: I held my fire on night 1 and took no shot.

I'm the Healer; night 1 I protected player_10 and no save was announced. player_5, your check on player_8 is the only hard claim so far, so I'd like to hear player_8's sigil claim tested against it. Vote-wise I'd lean player_3 or player_4 until the Sentinel/Trailseer clash resolves.

player_4, I'll correct myself: I did go to your door last night, so your visit line may be accurate. I hold no follow, and I won't say more about my night yet. Let's test the claimed roles before we vote on wording.

I'm the Healer, and I protected player_10 on night 1; no save was announced, so either no attack came or they're the unkillable Necromancer. Player_3 and player_4 can't both be right about the visit to player_4's door, so I'd test whose result names the wrong person before anyone votes. I'd lean toward player_4's claim being the false one, since a follow would not show who came to a door.
(passed)

Yes, I did go to your door last night, player_4, so that part of your result is right. But a visit from me proves nothing about me being a wolf, and it doesn't prove you followed me either. Who else are you following, and what did they do? Answer that before anyone votes.

I'm the Healer, and I protected player_10 on night 1 with no save announced. player_3 and player_4 both can't be right: player_5 is correct that a Sentinel watch would show player_3's own visit. I'd test player_3's Sentinel claim before anyone hangs on player_4's follow.
(passed)
